query:
INSERT INTO walkthroughs (title, description, category, difficulty, steps, estimatedMinutes, isActive) VALUES
('CRM Pipeline Management', 'Learn how to manage your sales pipeline, update deal stages, and log activities in a CRM system.', 'Sales Tools', 'beginner', '[{"id":1,"title":"Navigate to the Pipeline View","description":"Click on the Sales tab in the left sidebar, then select Pipeline from the dropdown menu. You should see a Kanban-style board with deal stages.","action":"Click Sales → Pipeline","targetElement":"#sidebar-sales","tip":"Use keyboard shortcut Ctrl+P to jump directly to the pipeline from anywhere."},{"id":2,"title":"Create a New Deal","description":"Click the + Add Deal button in the top right corner. Fill in the deal name, associated contact, estimated value, and expected close date.","action":"Click + Add Deal","targetElement":"#btn-add-deal","tip":"Always link a deal to a contact record — it keeps your activity history clean."},{"id":3,"title":"Move a Deal to the Next Stage","description":"Drag and drop the deal card from Qualified to Proposal Sent. Alternatively, open the deal and use the Stage dropdown at the top.","action":"Drag deal card to next column","targetElement":".deal-card","tip":"Moving a deal triggers an automatic task reminder for follow-up."},{"id":4,"title":"Log a Call Activity","description":"Open the deal, scroll to the Activity section, and click Log Activity. Select Call, add your notes, and set the outcome (Connected, Left Voicemail, No Answer).","action":"Click Log Activity → Call","targetElement":"#log-activity","tip":"Logged calls feed into your manager dashboard — keep notes detailed."},{"id":5,"title":"Set a Follow-up Task","description":"After logging the call, click Add Task. Set the due date, assign it to yourself, and choose the priority. The task will appear in your Today view.","action":"Click Add Task","targetElement":"#add-task","tip":"Tasks with a due date get surfaced in the daily digest email."}]', 8, true),
('Support Ticket Workflow', 'Master the end-to-end support ticket lifecycle from triage to resolution and CSAT collection.', 'Support Tools', 'beginner', '[{"id":1,"title":"Open the Ticket Queue","description":"Navigate to Support → Open Tickets. Tickets are sorted by priority (Urgent, High, Normal, Low). Red badges indicate SLA breach risk.","action":"Click Support → Open Tickets","targetElement":"#nav-support","tip":"Filter by Unassigned first to pick up tickets that need attention."},{"id":2,"title":"Triage and Assign a Ticket","description":"Click on an unassigned ticket. Review the customer message and category. Set the Priority, then click Assign to Me or select a team member from the dropdown.","action":"Set Priority and Assign","targetElement":"#ticket-assign","tip":"Correct priority setting is critical — it determines SLA timers."},{"id":3,"title":"Write and Send a Response","description":"In the reply box, type your response. Use the template library (lightning bolt icon) for common responses. Click Send Reply to deliver it to the customer.","action":"Click Send Reply","targetElement":"#reply-box","tip":"Always personalise templates — customers notice copy-paste responses."},{"id":4,"title":"Add an Internal Note","description":"Switch to the Internal Note tab in the reply box. Add context for your team (e.g. escalation reason, workaround tried). Internal notes are never visible to customers.","action":"Click Internal Note tab","targetElement":"#internal-note-tab","tip":"Good internal notes reduce resolution time when tickets are reassigned."},{"id":5,"title":"Resolve and Close the Ticket","description":"Once the issue is resolved, click the Resolve button. The system will automatically send a CSAT survey to the customer after 24 hours.","action":"Click Resolve","targetElement":"#btn-resolve","tip":"Do not close a ticket until the customer confirms resolution — reopened tickets hurt your metrics."}]', 10, true),
('HR Onboarding Workflow', 'Walk through the complete new hire onboarding process from offer acceptance to day-one readiness.', 'HR Tools', 'intermediate', '[{"id":1,"title":"Create a New Hire Record","description":"Go to People → New Hires → Add Employee. Enter the candidate details from the offer letter: name, role, start date, department, and manager.","action":"Click Add Employee","targetElement":"#add-employee","tip":"The start date triggers automated onboarding task sequences — set it accurately."},{"id":2,"title":"Send the Onboarding Pack","description":"From the new hire record, click Send Onboarding Pack. Select the appropriate template for the role (Engineering, Sales, Operations). The candidate receives a welcome email with a checklist.","action":"Click Send Onboarding Pack","targetElement":"#send-onboarding","tip":"Customise the welcome message — it sets the tone for the employee experience."},{"id":3,"title":"Track Document Completion","description":"Navigate to the Documents tab on the hire record. You can see which forms (contract, tax forms, policy acknowledgements) have been signed and which are pending.","action":"Click Documents tab","targetElement":"#docs-tab","tip":"Set a reminder for 48 hours before start date to chase outstanding documents."},{"id":4,"title":"Provision System Access","description":"Click IT Provisioning on the hire record. Check the required systems based on the role template, then click Submit Request. IT receives an automated ticket.","action":"Click IT Provisioning","targetElement":"#it-provisioning","tip":"Submit IT requests at least 5 business days before start date to avoid day-one delays."},{"id":5,"title":"Schedule Day-One Meetings","description":"Use the Calendar Integration to schedule the orientation session, manager 1:1, and team intro. These are automatically added to the new hire calendar once they accept.","action":"Click Schedule Meetings","targetElement":"#schedule-meetings","tip":"Include a lunch with the team on day one — it dramatically improves early retention."}]', 12, true),
('Email Campaign Builder', 'Build, test, and launch a targeted email marketing campaign from scratch.', 'Marketing Tools', 'intermediate', '[{"id":1,"title":"Create a New Campaign","description":"Go to Campaigns → Email → New Campaign. Give it a descriptive internal name (e.g. May 2026 - Re-engagement - Churned Users). Select the campaign type: Promotional, Transactional, or Nurture.","action":"Click New Campaign","targetElement":"#new-campaign","tip":"The internal name is never seen by recipients — be descriptive for your team."},{"id":2,"title":"Define Your Audience Segment","description":"In the Audience step, click Select Segment. Choose an existing segment or click Build Segment to create one using filters (e.g. last active > 90 days, plan = free).","action":"Click Select Segment","targetElement":"#audience-step","tip":"Always preview segment size before proceeding — avoid sending to < 50 contacts."},{"id":3,"title":"Design the Email","description":"Choose a template from the library or start from scratch. Use the drag-and-drop editor to add blocks: header, body text, CTA button, footer. Click Preview to see desktop and mobile views.","action":"Click Design Email","targetElement":"#design-step","tip":"Keep subject lines under 50 characters and test at least 2 variants."},{"id":4,"title":"Set Up A/B Testing","description":"Toggle on A/B Test in the Settings panel. Define variant B by changing the subject line or CTA text. Set the test split (e.g. 50/50) and the winning metric (open rate or click rate).","action":"Toggle A/B Test","targetElement":"#ab-toggle","tip":"Run A/B tests for at least 4 hours before declaring a winner."},{"id":5,"title":"Schedule and Launch","description":"In the Send step, choose Send Now or Schedule for Later. If scheduling, set the date and time. Click the timezone selector to match your audience. Then click Launch Campaign.","action":"Click Launch Campaign","targetElement":"#launch-btn","tip":"Send on Tuesday-Thursday between 9-11am in the recipient timezone for best open rates."}]', 10, true)
